orders.text:
A.O. No. 170 of 2013 
With 
CLMA No. 3638 of 2013
Hon’ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Mr. P.C. Maulekhi, Advocate, present for 
the appellant. 
 Heard. 
 This appeal is directed against award 
dated 28.02.2013, passed by Motor Accident 
Claims Tribunal/Additional District Judge, 
Vikas Nagar, Dehradun, in Motor Accident 
Claim Case No. 205 of 2006, whereby the 
Tribunal has awarded ` 20,81,872/- as 
compensation to the claimants. 
 Admit the appeal. 
 Summon the record of the Tribunal. 
 Issue notices to the respondents. 
 Having heard learned counsel for the 
appellant and after going through the impugned 
award, as an interim measure, it is directed that 
if the appellant New India Assurance Company 
Ltd. deposits 50% of the sum awarded by the 
the Tribunal (adjusting the statutory amount 
deposited before this Court), before it, within 
45 days from today, recovery in respect of 
remaining 50% of the sum awarded shall 
remain stayed, until further orders of this Court 
(Stay Application No. 3638 of 2013, stands 
disposed of). 
 List after service of notice on the 
respondents. 
(Prafulla C. Pant, J.)
16.04.2013 
JM

CLMA No. 8506 of 2013 
in 
AO No. 170 of 2013 
Hon’ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Mr. P.C. Maulekhi, Advocate, present for
the appellant.
Mr. Vikas Bahuguna, Advocate, present
for the claimant/respondent no. 1 Chitra Rani.
This is Money Withdrawal Application
No. 8506 of 2013, moved by the claimant/
respondent no. 1 for release of the amount
deposited by the appellant in compliance of
this Court’s order dated 16.04.2013 (in
connection with MAC case no. 205 of 2006
decided on 28.02.2013, by Motor Accident
Claims Tribunal/ Additional District Judge,
Vikas Nagar, Dehradun)
Heard.
Having heard learned counsel for the
appellant, and learned counsel for the claimant/
respondent no. 1, Money Withdrawal
Application No. 8506 of 2013, is disposed of
with the direction that ` 2.5 lac out of the sum
deposited by the appellant vide this Court’s
order dated 16.04.2013, shall be released in
favour of the claimant/ respondent no. 1 Chitra
Rani. Rest of the sum deposited by the
appellant shall be invested in the fixed deposit
to avoid loss of interest.
List this admitted appeal for final hearing
in due course.
 (Prafulla C. Pant, J.) 
Parul 14.08.2013

Hon’ble N.S. Dhanik, J.
Mr. P.C. Maulekhi, Advocate for 
the appellant.
Mr. Kaushal Sah Jagati, Advocate 
for respondent no. 1.
This is the second money 
withdrawal application which has 
been filed by respondent no.1
permitting her to withdraw the 
amount deposited before the learned 
Tribunal. 
After considering the submission 
of learned counsel for the parties, it is 
directed that Rs.2,50,000/- of the 
deposited amount be released in 
favour of respondent no. 1.
Rest of the amount shall be kept 
invested in TDR form.
List this matter after winter 
vacations for final hearing.
Money withdrawal application 
stands disposed of accordingly. 
 (N.S. Dhanik, J.)
